subject.title: Feature request: Self-hosting without a Cloudflare dependency

question: Should ClawRouter permanently support a non-Cloudflare production runtime, including ownership of equivalent policy, budget, identity, storage, queue, migration, and operational contracts?
rationale: The request changes the supported deployment model and long-term maintenance boundary; source inspection can establish the technical scope but cannot choose whether the project should own a second production runtime.

options.title: Sponsor a portable runtime contract
options.body: First design provider-neutral runtime interfaces and parity tests, then implement a reference Docker deployment without weakening enforcement guarantees.

options.title: Keep Cloudflare as the runtime
options.body: Continue supporting custom client origins while documenting that the ClawRouter server itself is Cloudflare-native and externally operated alternatives are separate implementations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a portable runtime contract
recommendation.body: First design provider-neutral runtime interfaces and parity tests, then implement a reference Docker deployment without weakening enforcement guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: The initial gateway commit established the runtime contracts that this decision would need to preserve or abstract.
